pages.title: Proof Certificate
pages.text: A proof, checked line by line, that a machine stays inside its limits. Use it on a multiblock's controller to file it there (up to four). Each one catches one containment failure: the machine still shuts down, but nothing is released. Made in the Formal Proof Assistant.

Made in $(item)Formal Proof Assistant$().$(br2)$(thing)Dropped by$(): Paradox Shade.$(br2)$(thing)Found in$(): Geometers Ruin, Liars Vault, Proof Stairs chests.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Proof by Induction.
